en: Links the [[frontmost]] and the [[rearmost]] heroes when a battle starts. The frontmost hero takes [[20%]] of the damage that would otherwise be dealt to the rearmost hero. Whenever the rearmost hero deals damage, the frontmost hero recovers HP equal to [[30%]] of the damage dealt. Whenever either linked hero gains Energy through any means other than this skill, the other hero gains [[15%]] of that Energy.
zh: 战斗开始时，链接己方[[最靠后]]和[[最靠前]]的各一名不同英雄。链接的前方英雄代替后方英雄承担[[20%]]的伤害；链接的后方英雄造成伤害时，使链接的前方英雄回复伤害量[[30%]]的生命值。链接双方的英雄通过该技能以外的方式获得能量时，使另一名友军获得这部分能量的[[15%]]。

en: Increases HP recovery to [[32%]] of the damage dealt.
zh: 生命值回复量提高至[[32%]]伤害量。
